title: DEBIE ZONE 2
description:
DEBIE ZONE 2

A fun & challenging action adventure platformer with Ledge Climbing, Narrow Passages, Grappling Hook, Free Falling, Compass, Parachute, Ziplines, and more!

Camera Switching System: 3rd person/1st Person

Sprint to cover vast distances in the blink of an eye

Parachute safely from heights or reach inaccessible areas

Dive into underwater worlds with swimming mechanics

Swing through the skies using a versatile grappling hook

Interact with switches, push objects, and ride moving platforms to solve puzzles and explore new horizons.

Action Adventure style challenges, traps, puzzles, etc

Additional Features:

Double Jump

Grappling Hook

Slidable Slopes

Sprint

Crouch

Dodge

Evade

Dash

Vault

Vine Wall Climb

Ledge Climb

Narrow Passages

Swim

Zipline

Parachute

Ladder Climb

Push Objects

Doors

Compass

Traps, Obstacles, and Moving Platforms

... and more!
